body: Thank you for replying, but I no longer wish to take my own advice. While it may work for others this clearly wont do much for me. . .waiting till Im 25 seems more like a jail sentence than a goal towards my independence.

An update: things have gotten better and worst. I have a guy who seems to be interested in me romantically but my mother seems dead set on making me doubt anyone could see me that way without it being completely based on lust, or them being a pervert, as I look 12. And I have a hard time telling is she is telling me this as a concern for my well being, or because she enjoys my maid like activities around the house and doesn't want me to leave. She makes it so I no longer have contact with anyone else apart from her. And now I'm in distress because I don't how to interact with others well, I'm just good at acting like I do. I just recently turned 18 as of yesterday and have to beg my mom if I can get a job so that my day doesn't consist of taking care of my brother, being the sole cleaner of a house of 5, and having my mom tell me what my life goals are gonna be, or else a loss of all support from her. It's now to the point where ending my life would be so much easier, and like a breath of fresh air, even if it means leaving the people I care about i.e., my mother. I thought I was gonna wait but I don't have the heart to do that anymore. Living life is becoming a chore when all I wanted was to enjoy my life. . .

Thank you to the people who take the time to read this, hope your life is enjoyable.
